caseNameFull: Wainwright, Secretary, Department of Offender Rehabilitation of Florida v. Sykes

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 883.] Motion of respondent for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that William F. Casler, Esquire, of St. Petersburg Beach, Fla., is appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
